breaking.change: Removed separately stepped environment sun updates; the visible sky, Sky-View LUT, key light and default live environment capture now share the current sun.
breaking.fix: Remove DayNight.step assignments. To trade lighting freshness for lower peak live-sky GPU cost with 13-frame capture cycles, set RenderSettings.skyCaptureSliced to true or apply the low quality preset.

added.summary: Explicit live sky capture latency/cost choice: false by default and on medium/high; true on low. Sliced faces retain their coherent sky snapshot rather than sampling a newer Sky-View LUT.

fixed.summary: Keep sunset terrain ambient and reflections current with the visible sky instead of retaining daylight across rapid dusk transitions.
